name: Thundering Smash
blurb: Active:  Volibear becomes  ghosted and gains  bonus movement speed for a few seconds, increased while facing an enemy champion.

effects.description: Active: Volibear drops on all fours, becoming ghosted and gaining bonus movement speed for 4 seconds, doubled while facing a nearby visible enemy champion.

During this time, Volibear's next basic attack has a modified windup time and is empowered to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus range, and pounce on the target, dealing bonus physical damage and stunning them for 1 second. This damage applies life steal.
If Volibear becomes immobilized or polymorphed by an enemy during Thundering Smash, the effect ends prematurely and the cooldown is reset.
Thundering Smash resets Volibear's basic attack timer.

notes:
Thundering Smash's bonus damage cannot  critically strike; the base damage of the attack can, however.
Despite this,  Randuin's Omen's Resilience reduces Thundering Smash's total damage.(bug)
Thundering Smash deals  basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as  spell damage.
Thundering Smash will still apply its effects to the target even if the  dash is  interrupted, but not if he goes into  resurrection.
Thundering Smash's dash cannot pass through natural terrain, but not through player-generated terrain.(unexpected)
Thundering Smash's attack triggers against  structures and  wards, consuming the effect but dealing its bonus damage, if applicable.
The windup for the attack completes even if the target becomes  untargetable but the  stun and damage do not apply.
The player's screen will flash red briefly and cue a sound effect when Volibear becomes  immobilized while Thundering Smash is active.
Thundering Smash's attack does not put Volibear's basic attack on cooldown.
This results in the same functionality as  Leona's  Shield of Daybreak and  Shyvana's  Emberstrike, effectively being a double attack reset.
If Thundering Smash's buff appears as the first on the buff bar, the empowered attack will fail against  structures.(bug)
